visualCharacteristics.purpose: Directory/detail cards with a heading, short description and a list of links (e.g. regions linking to the advisor directory, certification learning paths)
visualCharacteristics.layout: cards stacked; on desktop text and links on the left, optional image on the right; links flow in 1/2/3 columns by breakpoint

contentPattern.structure: One row per card; cell 1 optional image; cell 2 heading, optional description paragraph, then links (a bulleted list of links or one link per paragraph)

reuseGuidance: Use for cards whose main content is a group of navigational links under a heading. For image tiles with a single link use cards-industry.
